extracted.name: Captain's Vacation
extracted.description: Pineapple juice, Captain Morgan rum, and lemon-lime soda team up over ice to create an easy tropical cocktail that will appeal to any spiced rum fans.
instruction_lines: Fill a glass with ice. Pour in pineapple juice and spiced rum. Top off with enough lemon-lime soda to fill the glass.
